title: codemeta-drift check report
description: What `codemeta-drift <checkout> --json` writes. Keys this schema does not define are allowed: a release may add keys. Removing or retyping a key bumps schema_version. Contract: https://github.com/simonvanlierde/codemeta-drift/blob/main/docs/checks.md.

findings.description: The disagreements found. Empty when the check could not run (exit 3).

code.description: Stable identifier of the rule, such as TABLE_NO_TERM.

file.description: The file, or group of crosswalk files, where it shows.

term.description: The property or format it is about.

detail.description: What disagrees, for a human reader.

errors.description: Empty unless the check could not run (exit 3).

help.description: The next step to take, or null.
